rows.meaning: A part of a page with a registered class, such as a panel or a table.
The script that writes the site from the sources.
The script that enforces the rules, and names the rule and the file when it fails.
A short value that is computed from a file. A changed file gives another value.
A numbered section of a page.
A header from the server that tells the browser what a page may load and run.
A number that compares a text colour with its surface. A higher number is easier to read.
A named piece of a block, such as the head of a panel.
The body of a page, without the menu and the shell.
A fixed variant of a block, such as the primary button.
One folder that adds pages, styles or checks to the site.
A part of HTML that opens over a page without a script.
The list of every name that the stylesheet and the pages may use.
A list of every component of a piece of software.
A named value, such as a colour or a size, that the stylesheet uses.
